review_evidence: The 101 primary files contain modal/provability logics, Kripke semantics, Hilbert/Gentzen/labelled calculi, interpolation, completeness, search procedures and classification results.
ProvabilityLogic.lean is a large aggregation surface; playground files contain actual pretty-print/interface declarations. No content-level lossless exclusion was established.
summary: Reviewed ProvabilityLogic and retained all 101 primary files; the corpus is substantive formal logic and useful formal interfaces rather than repository-maintenance noise.
